projectDescription: A comprehensive command-line tool for interacting with the Dzaleka Digital Heritage API to access and manage refugee camp digital resources.
keyFeatures: Services Management - Browse and manage services with contact information and locations
Event Management - Access event details including registration and scheduling
Photo Archive - Upload, browse, and manage photos with metadata and albums
Population Statistics - View demographic data, trends, and nationality distributions
Resource Library - Download and manage digital resources and documents
API Health Monitoring - Check endpoint health with response time analysis
Rich Terminal Output - Beautiful colorized tables and panels using Rich library
Batch Operations - Download multiple resources or upload multiple photos efficiently
Data Export - Export data to CSV or generate detailed markdown reports
Search Functionality - Cross-resource search with filtering and relevance sorting
Interactive Shell - Command-line interface with history and tab completion
Configurable Settings - Customize API URL and timeout settings
publicApiSurface: dzdk health - Check API health status
dzdk services list - List available services with pagination and filtering
dzdk services get --id <id> - Get specific service details
dzdk events list - List events with pagination
dzdk events get --id <id> - Get specific event details
dzdk photos list - List photos with pagination
dzdk photos get --id <id> - Get photo details
dzdk photos upload --file <path> --title <title> - Upload a photo
dzdk photos metadata --id <id> - View photo metadata
dzdk photos edit --id <id> - Edit photo information
dzdk photos album create - Create a new album
dzdk photos album add - Add photos to an album
dzdk photos album list - List all albums
dzdk population stats - Get population statistics
dzdk resources list - List available resources
dzdk resources get --id <id> - Get resource details
dzdk resources fetch --id <id> --output <file> - Download a resource
dzdk search --query <query> - Search across all resources
dzdk batch download --type <type> --ids <ids> - Batch download resources
dzdk batch upload --directory <dir> --type <type> - Batch upload files
dzdk export csv --type <type> --output <file> - Export data to CSV
dzdk export report --type <type> --output <file> - Generate markdown report
dzdk stats services - Show service statistics
dzdk stats usage - Show usage statistics
dzdk config --url <url> --timeout <seconds> - Configure CLI settings
dzdk config --interactive - Interactive configuration mode
dzdk show-config - Display current configuration
dzdk shell - Start interactive shell mode
